description: Validates secret bundle specs for valid sources, env key mapping, namespace uniqueness, no plaintext values in YAML, valid path formats per source, and rotation policy compliance

rules.description: secret-bundle-spec.json must exist, be valid JSON, and declare namespace, environments, and a non-empty secrets array. Every secret entry must have a name, envKey, and a recognised source

Every secret's envKey must be declared in the env schema (env-schema-artifact.json) and marked secret: true. Without this cross-check, a secret bundle can inject values into env vars the runtime schema doesn't know about, causing startup validation errors. Falls back gracefully when no env-schema-artifact exists
rules.note: When env-schema-artifact.json is absent, validates only that all secrets have a non-empty envKey

rules.description: No two secrets may share the same name within the same namespace+environment combination. Duplicates cause non-deterministic secret resolution — whichever entry the store returns last silently wins

YAML files in the directory must not contain Kubernetes Secrets with literal stringData values longer than 8 characters. Plaintext k8s Secrets are only base64-encoded, not encrypted — anyone with kubectl get secret can read them. Use SealedSecrets or ExternalSecrets instead
rules.note: Skipped when no YAML files are present; variable references starting with ${ or $( are exempted

rules.description: Each secret's path field must conform to the expected format for its declared source. An incorrectly formatted path causes a runtime lookup failure when the application starts. sealed-secret sources do not require a path
secret-bundle-spec.json must not contain TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, or PLACEHOLDER markers

rotationPolicy must be declared and must be one of the recognised policies. At least one environment must be defined. Secret names within the bundle must be unique — duplicates cause non-deterministic resolution

constraints.secret-names: Must be unique within the bundle (separate from namespace-unique which checks namespace+env)
